_about: 隔空指点 — point the 剑诀 at the screen, a test game in the 游戏厅 (Hanli 2026-10-21: 「剑诀目前是手指朝上, 如果手指指向屏幕, 是否可行. 一个用户隔空双指点屏幕的demo视频, 也许能引起兴趣」; 「好，先做试玩」). The player holds 剑诀 (jieyin.json `seals.jian`, the one rule) with the two fingers at the camera: a quick jab toward the camera (`poke`) throws a 火蛋 that aims itself: the beast the player tapped, else the one nearest the bottom (守墙关's 结印 rule; Hanli 10-21 after a real-camera try: 「剑诀往前戳, 不好操作」「往前戳触发攻击, 但自动瞄准也可以」 — the 准星 that followed the fingers is gone). Beasts drift across the 山道 (`spawn`); hits in `seconds` give the stars. The seal is judged by joint angles on the 3D world points (games/jieyin/judge3d.js, `judge3d`), so it counts pointing up and pointing at the lens. No camera → one line, nothing else. 游戏厅 only; not in the story. doc/games.md § 隔空指点.
_judge3d: judge3d.js: a finger is straight when it bends (middle + end joints) less than `extDeg` in all, folded when more than `curlDeg`; `near` / `far` in palm-widths (index root → little-finger root). Loose on purpose (Hanli 10-21: easier): synthetic 剑诀 (pose.js), up or at the lens, depth squashed to 0.3: index/middle 0–12°, ring/little 132–157°, tips 0.51 palm apart; a V (fingers spread) 0.95 is refused fresh but may stay once 剑诀 is held (`loose` 15% wider). 剑诀 counts as held `graceMs` after it was last seen (it flickers while the hand jabs).
_poke: poke.js: the hand's size in the picture (wrist → index root + wrist → little-finger root + index root → little-finger root) grows by `grow` over its smallest in the last `windowMs` = a jab at the camera, 剑诀 held, `coolMs` after the last; then the size starts over from where it is. Where the hand points or moves sideways does not matter (the egg aims itself). Needs the camera read at ≥ `fps` (a 200 ms jab is 6 frames at 30, 3 at 15).
_hint: Over jieyin.json's `hint` for this game only: a hand pointed at the lens is foreshortened in the picture (wrist → middle root ~¼ of the same hand held up), so the hand hint's 'too far' comes at a quarter of 结印's.

title.en: Point in the air · The mountain road

levels._spawn: core.js: a beast every `everyMs` (± `jitter`), from either side on one of `lanes` (field height), at a speed in `speed` (field widths a second), `foes` by weight; `r` its hit radius (field width). Seeded: 再来 deals a fresh one.

lead.zh: 野兽一只只从山道上横穿过去。剑诀对准摄像头，两指指哪，准星就到哪——往前一点，火蛋出手。
lead.en: Beasts cross the mountain road one by one. Point the sword seal at the camera: the crosshair goes where the two fingers point — jab forward and the fire egg flies.
